title: Microsoft cuts 4,800 jobs and shrinks Xbox in 'significant restructure'
facts: Microsoft announced the elimination of 4,800 jobs across the company, representing roughly 2.1% of its total workforce.
The corporate layoffs include more than 1,600 immediate job cuts within the Xbox division.
Amy Coleman serves as executive vice president at Microsoft.
Asha Sharma serves as chief executive of Microsoft's Xbox division.
Microsoft announced the spin-off of four game studios: Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs.
The spin-off of four game development studios will remove an additional 1,600 roles from Xbox's direct headcount.
In 2024, Microsoft laid off more than 2,000 Xbox employees and closed four subsidiary game studios.
Microsoft previously announced plans to cut up to 9,000 corporate positions to fund artificial intelligence capital expenditures.
Minecraft developer Mojang and Candy Crush developer King will report directly to Xbox chief executive Asha Sharma.
Piers Harding-Rolls serves as an industry analyst at Ampere Analysis.
Game development studio Double Fine Productions was originally acquired by Microsoft in 2019.
Double Fine Productions developed the Psychonauts video game franchise.
Compulsion Games developed the action-adventure video game South of Midnight.
Both Double Fine Productions and Compulsion Games will retain their respective intellectual property following their departure from Microsoft.
Paolo Pescatore serves as an industry technology analyst.
